1959 is not a leap year (leap years are divisible by 4, but 1959 is not).  
277 days back from 1959-07-05:  
July 5 → back 5 days → June 30.  
Remaining: 277 − 5 = 272 days.  
Count back through months: June 30 days, May 31, April 30, March 31, February 28 (non-leap), January 31.  
Sum: 30+31+30+31+28+31 = 181 days (Jan 1 to June 30).  
272 − 181 = 91 days left before Jan 1, 1959.  
Go into 1958: December 31 back 1 day → Dec 31, remaining 90 days.  
December 31 days, November 30, October 31 → 31+30+31 = 92 days from Oct 1 to Dec 31.  
We need 90 days before Dec 31: Dec 31 → back 1 day = Dec 30, back 30 more days = Nov 30, back 31 more days = Oct 30, back 28 more days = Oct 2.  
Check: 1+30+31+28 = 90 days back from Dec 31 → Oct 2, 1958.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1958-10-02
